subject: Request: temporary quota uplift + retroactive overage credit (SumoRetail)
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@sumoretail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Spike during campaign — temporary quota increase & overage credit?

Hi Olga,

Quick one — we ran a targeted email-to-cart campaign yesterday and saw an unexpected burst that pushed us past our monthly quota. Our DevOps dug in and found ~18k duplicated generation calls between 09:12-09:45 UTC that look like they were caused by the Redwood JS SDK retry behavior combined with our retry wrapper. We attached a small log snippet.

Two asks: can you provision temporary headroom (we need ~60k tokens/day for the next 10 days) and can Redwood consider a retroactive credit for the duplicated overage while we sort our client-side fix? This is our busiest promo window and we want to avoid throttling.

Happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

—Aisha
Aisha Khan
Head of Growth, SumoRetail
attach: sdk-duplicate-requests-log-snippet.txt
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@sumoretail.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@sumoretail.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spike during campaign — temporary quota increase & overage credit?

Hi Aisha — thanks for the quick details and the log snippet.

First-pass: we can provision provisional headroom today to avoid throttles. Operationally I can raise your quota by +50% for 7 days immediately, and add a hard rate-limit floor so you don't encounter partial failures.

On the credit ask: we need to validate the duplications and confirm they were not due to upstream retries on our infra. If the root cause is client-side (SDK+wrapper) we typically approve a one-time partial credit — we can propose a 20% credit on the overage attributable to the duplicated requests, capped at $12k for this event. If product/billing confirms an SDK issue on our side we will increase that.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I've attached a short provisional uplift quote and updated MAP for your review.
- Please share a fuller log (timestamped traces around the spike) and confirm the campaign windows.
- Procurement: if you can issue a short PO for the uplift days, we can avoid invoicing surprises.

If you're available I can do a 20-min call now or tomorrow morning PT.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attach: provisional-uplift-quote.pdf; MAP_SumoRetail_v1.pdf
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SumoRetail — temporary quota uplift + credit ask (context & recommended path)

Team — forwarding SumoRetail's request. Key points:
- Customer saw ~18k duplicate generation calls during a 33-minute spike; they want temporary capacity (~60k tokens/day for 10 days) and a retro credit for duplicated overage.
- I proposed +50% quota for 7 days immediately and a one-time 20% credit on the duplicated overage, capped at $12k, pending validation.

Recommended internal actions:
1) Billing: provisionally approve a one-time 20% credit (capped $12k) tied to the duplicated token volume. We'll reconcile after logs/telemetry.
2) Product/Support (Markus): run a quick check to confirm whether Redwood SDK behavior or server-side retries could have contributed. We need an ETA on root cause (24–48h).
3) CSM (Rafael): coordinate the PO and the customer's launch calendar; confirm whether they want the +50% uplift for 7 or 10 days (Aisha asked 10 days).
4) Legal (if necessary): if we move beyond a $12k cap or change SLA terms, surface it.

I want to keep this as a sales goodwill move — we don't want a throttle during peak promo. If billing agrees, I'll send a formal MAP amendment and the provisional uplift now.

Thoughts?
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: SumoRetail — temporary quota uplift + credit ask (context & recommended path)

Agree with Olga's path. A couple of notes:
- Finance: we can provisionally approve up to $12k credit as a service gesture; we'll require a short reconciliation (logs/telemetry) before final write-off.
- Procurement: ask for a PO for the uplift window so we can bill cleanly if they exceed the provisional uplift.
- Deal id: SUMO-2026-42 (tracking) — I will set this as a short-term enablement with Ben to ensure we capture the SKU change for next month.

If Markus can confirm product side within 48h, I'll sign off.
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@sumoretail.com>, Procurement <procurement@sumoretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-27T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: provisional +50% uplift (7 days) and proposed 20% duplicate-credit (capped)

Hi Aisha — quick update and confirmation:

We have provisionally enabled a +50% token uplift on your account for 7 days starting now to keep the campaign safe from throttles. This is a temporary operational measure while we validate root cause.

Regarding credits: Finance has provisionally approved the one-time 20% credit on duplicated overage, capped at $12,000, pending reconciliation of the logs you supplied and our product team's review. If product confirms a Redwood SDK/infra bug contributed materially, we'll increase the credit and expedite remediation support.

Please:
- Send the full timestamped trace for the 09:12-09:45 UTC window (we need request IDs if possible).
- Confirm whether you want the uplift extended to 10 days (you originally asked for 10; we provisioned 7 to limit exposure). If you need 10 days we can extend with a short PO to cover extra uplift.

I'll follow up with an amended MAP and a DocuSign link for the temporary uplift amendment. Thanks for the quick collaboration here — we'll prioritize the RCA.

—Olga
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
